items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: I went with Herbie Fields. Small band. Went with Herbie Fields and then I played around Philadelphia and New York...

ctx.x: Well, what did you do when you left Basie?

Well, when I left Basie in '50, the first thing I had to do was join 802, because we were a traveling band all those years. None of us was a member of 802 but New York musicians like Dicky Wells, Benny Morton and guys like that that lived in New York, had to join the union. And then I went with Buddy Rich. No, first I went with Herbie Fields.
Yes, that was a small band, wasn't it?

items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Herbie Fields at the time. I was just freelancing, I played with everybody.

ctx.x: So, this was a little earlier.
A little earlier than that, this was right after the Basie band had broken up in 1950. So, then I …Herbie Fields at the time. I was just freelancing, I played with everybody.
You were based in New York.
